name: Explicit cross-reference
definition: A passage names another prophet, writing, saying, or prior Scripture.

name: Explicit identification
definition: The passage or an interpreting messenger states what a symbol, title, or object is.

name: Shared wording/entity/number
definition: Passages share a title, phrase, named place, person, number, or image.

name: Stated chronological relation
definition: The text states order, duration, reign, year, before, after, until, from, or to.

name: Observed verbal parallel
definition: Multiple details resemble one another, but no passage explicitly links them.
